test_title: PYST 10: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

__No sooner had he got out of her sight that__ she proceeded to tamper with the letter.

options.text: No sooner did he got out of her sight and
As soon as he got out of her sight than
No sooner had he got out of her sight than

solution:
The correct answer is** 'No sooner had he got out of her sight than'.**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'No sooner had he got out of her sight than' **should be used instead of** 'No sooner had he got out of her sight that'.**

 
• We know that 'No sooner' is followed by 'than'. 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *No sooner had I started mowing the lawn than it started raining. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a779acc017790d2eea790cc9122762921b180090c4a6901b9133fe30db56bd.png] *
 
• *No sooner had I started mowing the lawn then it started raining. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91b169c9a6aba309887b5e1410c56688829831001bc1448ed23f1bec5eca1d8.png] *
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4. 

 

Correct Sentence:__ **No sooner had he got out of her sight than** she proceeded to tamper with the letter.*
